    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    blocks = []
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            if grid[r][c] == grid[r][c + 1] == grid[r + 1][c] == grid[r + 1][c + 1] == 2:
                blocks.append((r, c))

    rays = []
    anchors = []
    directions = [(-1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, -1), (1, 1)]
    for r, c in blocks:
        positions = [(r - 1, c - 1), (r - 1, c + 2), (r + 2, c - 1), (r + 2, c + 2)]
        colors = [grid[i][j] if 0 <= i < h and 0 <= j < w else 0 for i, j in positions]
        rotated = [colors[2], colors[0], colors[3], colors[1]]
        for k, ((i, j), color, (di, dj)) in enumerate(zip(positions, rotated, directions)):
            if 0 <= i < h and 0 <= j < w:
                out[i][j] = color
                anchors.append((i, j, color, k == 0))
                rays.append((i, j, color, di, dj))

    for i, j, color, di, dj in rays:
        x, y = i + di, j + dj
        while 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w:
            if grid[x][y] == 2:
                break
            out[x][y] = color
            stop = False
            for a, b, other_color, is_nw in anchors:
                if is_nw and (a, b) != (i, j) and other_color == color:
                    distance = max(abs(x - a), abs(y - b))
                    next_distance = max(abs(x + di - a), abs(y + dj - b))
                    if distance <= 1 and next_distance <= distance:
                        stop = True
                        break
            if stop:
                break
            x += di
            y += dj
    return out
'''
